A Magical Christmas Outdoor Movie Night with The Broom Tree

The holiday season is here, and we’re excited to invite you and your family to a night of festive fun under the stars! On Wednesday, December 6th, at 6 PM, join us at the Ward 10 Ballpark in Tioga for a special Christmas outdoor movie night.

This event is more than just a movie—it’s a chance to connect with your community in a warm, welcoming environment. At The Broom Tree, we’re dedicated to supporting families with special needs children, but our events are always open to everyone.

Event Details:

  • When: December 6, 2023, at 6 PM
  • Where: Ward 10 Ballpark, Tioga
  • Cost: Free admission
  • Optional Snacks: $3 at the gate gets you endless fresh-popped popcorn and a drink! 🍿🥤

Bring your lawn chairs, cozy blankets, and your holiday spirit for an unforgettable evening of joy, togetherness, and community. Let’s kick off the Christmas season with laughter, love, and a great family-friendly movie!

We can’t wait to see you there!

Get ready to run, splash, and support an incredible cause! The Broom Tree invites you to our annual Dash & Splash 5K and 1-Mile Fun Run—our biggest fundraiser of the year, supporting the life-changing work we do for families of children with disabilities in Central Louisiana.

Proceeds go directly to The Broom Tree and help fund:

Our grant program, which helps families afford essential items insurance won’t cover (like adaptive car seats, strollers, therapy equipment, and travel to appointments)
Parents’ Night Out, a respite program that gives caregivers a much-needed break
Caregiver Café, our support group for parents raising children with disabilities

💧 After completing the 5K or 1-mile course, runners will slide into the finish line with a giant slip and slide or water jumper/slide combo—so bring your floaties, wear your hula skirt, or dress in something silly and splash-friendly!

🎉 After the race, stick around for:

Family games & water fun
Music & food trucks
Community and connection
This is more than a run—it’s a fun-filled, family-friendly day that brings hope and support to those who need it most. Come out, get messy, and help us make a difference—one splash at a time.

Register today and let’s run with purpose!

At The Broom Tree, we host a variety of fundraising events throughout the year to support our mission of uplifting families with children who have disabilities. Our Family Fun Day is a highlight, offering a day filled with games, activities, food, and entertainment for all ages, fostering a sense of community and joy. We also organize an annual 5K run, encouraging fitness and community participation while raising crucial funds. In addition to these, we host numerous other events, such as benefit concerts, silent auctions, and seasonal festivals. Each event is designed to bring people together, raise awareness, and generate the necessary support to continue our work, ensuring every family feels valued and supported.

It’s a fantastic opportunity for your children to hang out, make friends, and enjoy a memorable time, all while you get a few hours to relax and recharge.
